title: osmundastrum cinnamomeum subsp. asiaticum
intro: Osmundastrum cinnamomeum subsp. asiaticum, commonly known as the Asian royal fern, is a subspecies of fern that belongs to the family Osmundaceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its ability to expel heat and toxins from the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which can help relieve coughs, bronchitis, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Osmundastrum cinnamomeum subsp. asiaticum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
